objective: Retrieve existing delegation/helper evidence for candidate pairs, without deciding equivalence or recommending refactors
inputs: Fixed source units, candidate IDs, snapshot and source identity; compiler facts only after exact artifact/config validation
development_cases: 18 reviewed pairs in discovery-ledger-v4.json; analyst has seen answers
mechanism: Extract bounded direct call syntax candidates with existing Rust parser; retrieve possible same-snapshot definitions, preserve ambiguous/missing/macro/config status. Prefer validated compiler resolution when available, never guess trait or dynamic targets.

comparison.B: Same bodies plus deterministic adjacent source context
comparison.C: Same bodies plus call-candidate definition snippets
comparison.budget: Identical 16384-byte UTF-8 source payload ceiling per pair, at most eight snippets; preserve identical candidate bodies in every arm. Record actual bytes and unused capacity; not an LLM-token-equated experiment.
comparison.overflow: If bodies alone exceed budget, mark not_evaluated_budget rather than truncate secretly
comparison.implementation_prerequisite: Freeze window allocation, tie-breaking, recursive expansion depth and ambiguous-target budget rules before running retrieval

measurements: Known necessary evidence span hits per pair and union bytes within budget, based on explicit development reference spans
Retrieved definitions confirmed correct, ambiguous, incorrect or unavailable; unknowns remain visible
Whether evidence is sufficient for an already-delegates judgment versus still unknown, recorded separately from equivalence and benefit
Actual source bytes, wall time and missing reasons; no automatic token-saving claim
evaluation_limits: Reference spans are incomplete researcher development targets, not an exhaustive semantic-recall denominator. Do not tune and then evaluate on the same 18 pairs as held-out evidence.
stop_conditions: Snapshot or artifact mismatch stops association; missing compiler facts is not absence of a call
If syntax target ambiguity dominates, record it instead of building a whole-program resolver
If C gives no useful evidence gain over equal-budget B, preserve negative result and reconsider the mechanism
No new patches, graph database or LLM scoring model during this pilot
next_action: First try to obtain the exact manifest-listed kvfs artifact and reuse the existing auditor; if unavailable, record the gap and use explicitly unresolved syntax candidates rather than build another compiler extractor. Freeze retrieval details and development reference spans before running the smallest evidence-packet comparison.
